## Scope and selection

The study ran `agentic_gpt6_luna_bm25_e5` for 400 queries per round with seed 42 and nine cache-salt rounds (round-1, round-2, round-3, round-4, round-5, round-6, round-7, round-8, round-9). English-query analysis uses ESCI `product_locale=us`, the dataset's US-English locale (294 of 400 sampled queries). Query selection is post-hoc. The same query sample appears in all nine runs. NDCG-G is computed from the ESCI graded judgments. Only queries with at least one positive-grade judgment are included.

| Round | Sampled queries | English queries | Mean English NDCG-G |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| round-1 | 400 | 294 | 0.501 |
| round-2 | 400 | 294 | 0.502 |
| round-3 | 400 | 294 | 0.500 |
| round-4 | 400 | 294 | 0.499 |
| round-5 | 400 | 294 | 0.516 |
| round-6 | 400 | 294 | 0.512 |
| round-7 | 400 | 294 | 0.500 |
| round-8 | 400 | 294 | 0.503 |
| round-9 | 400 | 294 | 0.500 |

Ideal results use positive-grade judgments sorted by grade descending and document ID ascending, up to rank 10; they are not padded with grade-0 documents. Hover over a title to view its full product description. No product images are included. `NA` means the result was not judged; grade 0 is an explicit irrelevance judgment. ESCI grades are E=3, S=2, C=1, I=0.

Continuous hinges, also called piano hinges, provide support to run the full length of the doors, panels, or pieces being joined together. They are manufactured in a variety of materials and sizes, with or without holes, finished or unfinished, and can be cut to specific sizes. They also vary by knuckle length, pin diameter, leaf thickness, and open width. The knuckle is the tubular part of the hinge through which the pin passes, and knuckle length is the measurement of an individual section. The pin runs the length of the hinge holding the leaves together. The leaf is the flat metal portion of the hinge that extends laterally from the knuckle and revolves around the pin.
